redactionTab.intro: Text matching these rules is replaced with [REDACTED:<rule>] before it leaves Provisa: in exported traces and logs, container output, the audit log and error messages returned to clients. The organization's own secrets are redacted automatically.
redactionTab.bestEffort: Redaction is best effort. The built-in patterns are a starter set, not a guarantee: add patterns here for your organization's own sensitive formats. A source's own logs are out of Provisa's reach.
redactionTab.unresolved: These reference rules do not resolve and redact nothing: {{names}}
redactionTab.automaticHelp: Secrets in this organization's vault and every secret its model names, by name only. Values resolved for individual users are added as they are used ({{count}} so far).
redactionTab.name: Name
redactionTab.saved: Saved. The rules apply from now on.
